keyword: how many google reviews do you need to rank
angle: Specific review count thresholds that separate ranked local businesses from invisible ones, backed by 2025-2026 industry data.
secondary_kw: how many reviews does a business need
google reviews local SEO ranking factor

stats.claim: 47% of consumers won't use a business that has fewer than 20 reviews, and only 9% will use one with 5 or fewer reviews — making 20 reviews a hard trust floor for local businesses.
74% of consumers only care about reviews written in the last three months, meaning review velocity — not just total count — is a critical trust and ranking signal.
stats.value: 74% of consumers only trust reviews from the last 3 months

stats.claim: Businesses ranking in Google local positions 1–3 have approximately 21% more reviews than profiles ranked 4–10, demonstrating a direct correlation between review volume and top-pack placement.
stats.value: 21% more reviews for top-3 vs positions 4–10

stats.claim: A Sterling Sky case study found that crossing 10 reviews produced a measurable local ranking lift across three tested businesses; gains plateaued immediately after, suggesting 10 reviews is a meaningful algorithm threshold — not a linear one.
stats.value: 10 reviews is the inflection point for ranking improvement

stats.claim: Local Falcon's analysis of 50.4 million search results across 1,993 categories found median review counts vary enormously by category — from 28 for general contractors to 976 for breakfast restaurants — and metro areas require 1.5–2x as many reviews as rural areas to compete.
stats.value: Median reviews range from 28 (contractors) to 976 (restaurants) by category
stats.source_name: Local Falcon Whitepaper: 50 Million Search Results

stats.claim: For every 10 new reviews a business earns, Google Business Profile conversion rate improves by 2.8%, and businesses with above-average review counts generate 82% more annual revenue than those below average.
stats.value: 2.8% conversion lift per 10 reviews; 82% more revenue above average review count
